description_en: Creates a network access rule to configure the private IP addresses or private CIDR blocks that are allowed to access a Key Management Service (KMS) instance
description_zh: 创建一条网络控制规则，设置允许访问KMS的私网IP或私网的网段

name: CreateNetworkRule

parameters.help_en: The name of the access control rule
